description_expanded: This enchanting cottage tucked off Scenic 30A is part of a vacation rental compound located in the captivating historic village center of Grayton Beach . Goodnight Moon is the main residence of Magnolia House and includes three bedrooms, three full baths, and can host up to seven lucky beachgoers. This newly renovated cottage is tucked away behind some Live Oak trees and Palmettos, providing a serene setting with a furnished screened-in covered front porch for relaxing. The bright, spacious interiors include sunny windows and a soaring vaulted ceiling in the open living, dining, and kitchen area, where rich hardwood floors flow throughout. A pale blue wraparound couch adorned with colorful pillows and two comfortable white armchairs sits beside a round brown cocktail table. A large flatscreen TV mounted above a unique rustic cabinet provides entertainment. The dining area in a cornered window location has a round white table with a cheerful checkered cushion bench on two sides and two bamboo framed chairs. The open kitchen nearby has a white island table with a butcher block top and two square metal stools for wining and dining. White open shelving, a gleaming subway tile backsplash, brushed stainless steel appliances, and a fashionable retro-style turquoise refrigerator-freezer provide everything needed to create a fun family meal. The primary bedroom includes a king-size bed with a distinctive dove gray shutter headboard and two side tables with regal black base lamps facing a large flatscreen TV mounted on a dark ebony dressing cabinet. A chic patterned armchair sits beside a seascape painting and a wall-mounted nautical boat propeller. The luxurious ensuite bath has a double vanity sink cabinet with a veined marble surface and a glass-walled walk-in shower. One of the guest bedrooms resembles a primary suite with a king-size bed featuring a handsome black decorative metal headboard and a private bath with a veined marble sink vanity and a glass-walled walk-in shower. It also includes a flatscreen TV along with chic furnishings, including a white-washed bench pew, two bedside tables, and an antique shelving cabinet. A bunk room with a full and twin bed provide sleeping quarters for the kids, while a wall-mounted flatscreen TV provides evening entertainment. The bunk room utilizes a full hall bath with a tub shower combination that also serves as a convenient powder room. This outstanding Grayton Beach locale is a short stroll from the historic village center, providing a charming, laid-back setting mindful of wonderful golden yesteryears. The famous Red Bar is there featuring great food, craft cocktails, wine, beer, and live musical entertainment. The unique Zoo Gallery is right across the street with a vibrant, colorful array of colorful decorative art, jewelry, and one-of-a-kind beach-inspired furnishings created by select artists nationwide. The Tribe Kelley Surf Post next door offers an awesome array of chic coastal clothing and fashionable accouterments. The nearby Chiringo’s Restaurant & Bar features Spanish Tapas, seafood, favorite drinks, and seasonal entertainment. The renowned AJ’s Seafood & Oyster Bar is also within walking distance featuring delicious gulf-caught entrees and rollicking live bands every night. Many other restaurants, beach bars, shopping adventures, amphitheater concerts, along with fun festivals are minutes away in the iconic Seaside and Santa Rosa Beach village center of Gulf Place . First Floor: Living Room with Patio Access, King Primary Bedroom with Walk-In Shower, King Bedroom with Walk-In Shower, Bunk Room with Full/Twin Bunk, Hall Bath with Tub/Shower Combo, Laundry.
